name: Desert Leaf-cutter Ant
desc: Desert Leaf-cutter Ant (Acromyrmex versicolor): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 3 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Acromyrmex versicolor is known as the desert leafcutter ant. A. versicolor is found during the summer months in the Colorado and Sonoran deserts when there is precipitation.
